purpose: Mask-driven feature scatter/decal policy for M15. Current runtime uses procedural review primitives; authored assets should replace the recipes without changing masks or visibility bands.

iso.reason: Tactical view should see shrubs and stone masses but avoid close-only clutter.

medium_3d.reason: Organic identity shifts from flat terrain tiles to feature layers.

close_3d.reason: Close band validates asset shape, density, and prototype-to-authored replacement.

shrub.prototype_recipe: multi-lobed low shrub with woody core
shrub.authored_asset_target: scrub brush / low desert shrub GLB variants

dry_grass.prototype_recipe: crossed blade cards plus seed heads
dry_grass.authored_asset_target: dry grass clump cards with LOD billboard fallback

stone.prototype_recipe: warm box slabs plus lighter caps
stone.authored_asset_target: world/props rock_small variants or OpenTopo-derived stones

lichen_decal.authored_asset_target: irregular decal cards or projected terrain decals

promotion_gate: No hand placement; placement must remain mask-driven and deterministic.
Topdown must remain readable with scatter hidden by default.
Iso/medium/close must be captured before promotion.
Authored replacement assets must keep explicit LOD/visibility ranges.
Do not promote prototype primitives as final content.
